title: 我注意到这批货没按计划到…（1/2）
sentences: I noticed the shipment hasn't arrived as scheduled. Could you tell me what's going on?
I understand, but I need a specific date. When can you guarantee delivery?
Let's put that in writing. If it slips again, we'll need to discuss compensation.
desc: 我注意到这批货没按计划到，能说说是什 / 我理解，但我需要一个具体日期。什么时 / 我们把这个写下来。如果再延，需要谈赔

title: 我们最晚下周三能确认到货（2/2）
sentences: We can confirm arrival by next Wednesday at the latest.
Could you tell me why the shipment was delayed?
desc: 我们最晚下周三能确认到货。 / 能告诉我货为什么延误吗？ / 这是我的底线。
